// Package guided has a component with a mechanical site and a guided one,
// which an agent migrates by hand between plans.
package guided

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go/jetstream"
)

func Drain(nc *nats.Conn) (int, error) {
	js, err := jetstream.New(nc)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	info, err := js.AccountInfo(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	acked := 0
	// guided: begin
	sub, err := js.CreateOrUpdateConsumer(context.Background(), "ORDERS", jetstream.ConsumerConfig{
		Durable:       "worker",
		FilterSubject: "orders.new",
	})
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	batch, err := sub.Fetch(10)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	for m := range batch.Messages() {
		if err := m.Ack(); err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		acked++
	}
	if err := batch.Error(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	// guided: end
	return info.Streams + acked, nil
}
